targets.name: ழ (zha)
targets.summary: ழ is made with the tongue tip curled back toward the roof of the mouth, without touching it. The air and voice flow smoothly over the tongue.
steps: Open your mouth a little and keep your jaw relaxed.
Lift your tongue tip and curl it back, so the underside of the tip faces the roof of your mouth.
Bring it close to the roof of your mouth, but do not touch. Leave a small gap.
Let your voice flow through the gap. It should sound smooth and continuous, a little like a soft 'r'.

ள.tip: Your tongue may be touching the roof of your mouth. For ழ, keep the curled tip just below the roof — close, but not touching — and let the sound flow.

ல.tip: Your tongue tip may be flat against the ridge behind your top teeth. For ழ, curl the tip further back and do not let it touch.

ய.tip: The middle of your tongue may be rising instead of the tip. Lift the tip itself and curl it backwards.

targets.name: ள (La)
targets.summary: ள is made by curling the tongue tip back and pressing it against the roof of the mouth, while the air flows out around the sides of the tongue.
steps: Curl your tongue tip back a little, like for ழ.
Press the tip against the roof of your mouth, just behind the bumpy ridge behind your top teeth.
Keep it touching and turn your voice on. The air flows out around the sides of your tongue.
Let go smoothly into the vowel that follows.

ல.tip: Your tongue tip may be touching just behind your top teeth. For ள, curl it further back before it touches the roof of your mouth.

ழ.tip: Your tongue may not be touching the roof. For ள, press the curled tip firmly against the roof of your mouth.

4.meaning: There is a fish in the pond

5.meaning: I walk to school every morning

targets.name: ர (ra)
targets.summary: ர is a quick, light tap: the tongue tip flicks once against the ridge just behind the upper teeth.
steps: Rest your tongue tip behind your lower teeth.
Flick the tip up to touch the ridge just behind your upper teeth for a split second.
Let it drop straight away — one quick tap, with your voice on.
Practise a quick 'அர அர அர' to feel the tap.

ல.tip: Your tongue may be staying pressed on the ridge. For ர, make it a quick flick: touch and let go immediately.

ய.tip: The middle of your tongue may be rising instead of the tip. Use the tip for one quick tap on the ridge.

ழ.tip: Your tongue tip may be curling back. For ர, tap the ridge just behind your upper teeth instead.

5.meaning: There are big trees in my town

targets.name: र (ra)
targets.summary: र is a quick, light tap: the tongue tip flicks once against the ridge just behind the upper teeth.
steps: Rest your tongue tip behind your lower teeth.
Flick the tip up to touch the ridge just behind your upper teeth for a split second.
Let it drop straight away — one quick tap, with your voice on.
Practise a quick 'अरा अरा अरा' to feel the tap.

ल.tip: Your tongue may be staying pressed on the ridge. For र, make it a quick flick: touch and let go immediately.

य.tip: The middle of your tongue may be rising instead of the tip. Use the tip for one quick tap on the ridge.

ड़.tip: Your tongue tip may be curling back before it flicks. For र, tap the ridge right behind your upper teeth without curling.

5.text: आज रात आसमान में बहुत तारे हैं
5.roman: aaj raat aasmaan mein bahut taare hain
5.meaning: There are many stars in the sky tonight

targets.name: श (sha)
targets.summary: श is a 'sh' sound: the front of the tongue rises just behind the ridge, the lips push slightly forward, and a steady stream of air flows out.
steps: Bring your teeth close together.
Round your lips slightly and push them a little forward.
Raise the front of your tongue toward the area just behind the ridge, without touching.
Blow a steady stream of air: 'shhh'.

स.tip: That came out closer to स (s). Pull your tongue slightly back from your teeth, round your lips a little, and blow: 'shhh'.

4.meaning: The lion came in the evening

5.text: शनिवार की शाम हम शहर घूमने गए
5.roman: shanivaar ki shaam ham shahar ghoomne gaye
5.meaning: On Saturday evening we went around the city

targets.name: ख (kha)
targets.summary: ख is क with a puff of air. The back of the tongue touches the soft back part of the roof of the mouth, then lets go with a breath.
steps: Raise the back of your tongue so it touches the soft back part of the roof of your mouth.
Let a little air build up behind it.
Let go with a strong puff of air. Hold your palm in front of your mouth to feel it.
Say क, then ख, and feel the difference on your palm.

क.tip: We heard क — the puff of air may be missing. Hold your palm in front of your mouth and let go with a strong breath of air.

ग.tip: Your voice may be switching on too early. Keep your voice off at the start and let go with a puff of air.

5.text: खिड़की खोलकर ताज़ी हवा आने दो
5.roman: khidki kholkar taazi hawa aane do
5.meaning: Open the window and let fresh air in
